newsitem.title: UK: BP extends gains as SBC Warburg upgrades.
newsitem.headline: BP extends gains as SBC Warburg upgrades.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum Plc extended early gains on Friday, rising three percent, as SBC Warburg upgraded the stock.
By 0919 GMT, BP shares were up 21-1/2p to 736 in active trade.
The brokerage declined to provide details, but dealers said Warburg upgraded the stock to "add" from "hold."

Additionally, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated its positive stance, advising clients to buy the shares. The brokerage cited underlying strong fundamentals and expectations for growth. OPEC's agreement to commit to production quotas was not a factor, Kleinwort said.
The shares got an early boost on the back the OPEC agreement and expectations that oil prices are poised to firm, dealers said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
